utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard how the repair drive’s shaping up? I was just wondering who’s bringing tools and who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I haven’t heard for sure yet — are we actually set on the repair drive? If you’ve got the list, I can check who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the list yet, but I’ll ask around and pass it along as soon as I hear who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I heard folks are getting a repair drive going—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think people are still figuring out the details, but I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah—once you hear the details, pass them my way and I’ll help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just the tables, a few tool donations, and a couple more volunteers for setup. Everything else seems on track.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help with tables or setup. Just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I heard a little about the repair drive, but I don’t really know the details yet. What are folks hoping to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the leaky gutters by the community room and a few broken porch steps, from what I’ve heard. I’m starting a supply list now, so I’m checking what folks already have before we buy anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I might be able to help with tools or extra wood if you need it. What supplies are you still missing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, I’m trying to work around school pickup times—when were you thinking of holding the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking Saturday late morning, maybe 10 to 1, so folks can come by after breakfast and still have the afternoon free. Would that work around pickup schedules on your end?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that should work well for me—Saturday late morning is much easier around pickup times. I can help with that window.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: let’s pick a time, list the repairs, and go one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds good to me, Eli. Remind me what time you were thinking, and I’ll keep my list ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start Saturday at 9 in the morning, if that suits you. Bring your list, and we’ll begin at my place before moving down the block.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—do you know anyone who might want to bring something by or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe, but I’d need the drop-off time and where things should go first. I’m a bit cautious about the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair, Pia—I’ll check the exact drop-off time and location first, then swing back with the details before you pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rosa, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—do you know what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — we still need a few volunteers for the sign-up table, plus someone to sort tools and label donated parts. If you’re free, I’d love to put you where it’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help at the sign-up table if that’s useful, though I may need a quick rundown since I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara, I’d like to help with the repair drive—can you tell me what needs fixing first and who’s already volunteered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana, I’m still getting the first repair list and volunteer names together, so I don’t want to guess—can I check with the organizers and get back to you today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Mara—thank you for checking first. I’ll wait for your update today before I commit to a specific task.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can’t do much, Dane, but I might have a few tools to lend if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That helps a lot, Uli—honestly, even a few extra tools could keep folks moving. I’m late getting organized as usual, but I can swing by and pick them up whenever suits you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe tomorrow morning, if that’s all right. I’ll leave them by the back door so you don’t have to fuss.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools for the repair drive if you need them. Just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools can you lend, and are there any you’d need back the same day?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a socket set, cordless drill, screwdrivers, pliers, and a couple clamps; I’d just need the drill and socket set back that evening.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — where’s the repair drive happening, and what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the community room by the laundromat, I think around 10 Saturday—check the flyer to be safe, but that’s what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community room by the laundromat, around 10 on Saturday; I’ll check the flyer to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—if you need extra tools or a spare pair of hands, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I end up needing help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—just give me a holler when you know what you need, and I’ll bring whatever tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the schedule and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fair, Pia — I’d want those confirmed too. I’ll ask around for the exact times and drop-off spot before we count on anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira. Once we have that, I can figure out whether I’m able to help without making a mess of the day.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word to both groups?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please—thank you. That would help a lot, especially if you can reach both groups.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll message both groups today and let them know where and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I’m starting a quick list for the repair drive—do we already know what supplies folks need most?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just catching up, Cleo, so I don’t know the full list yet. My guess is basics like tape, gloves, and spare parts, but I can ask around and add what folks actually need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane—if you ask around, I’ll start the list with tape, gloves, and spare parts as tentative needs for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Faye! I was just wondering how the repair drive is coming along—have you heard who’s bringing what yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Tess — I’m still lining things up with the families, but I should have a clearer list soon. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye—once you’ve got the list, I can help spread the word so folks know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I heard there’s a repair drive happening—what’s the quick version of what you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo—quick version is we need volunteers to help check folks in, sort small appliances and bikes, and keep the coffee table stocked. If you can give me a two-hour window, I’ll plug you into the easiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do two hours, sure—put me wherever’s easiest, maybe coffee or check-in. What time slot do you need covered most?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you take the Saturday 10–12 intake table and bring a roll of masking tape?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’ll cover the Saturday 10–12 intake table and bring a roll of masking tape.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m helping get the word out about the repair drive—want me to swing by later with the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that would be great. I’ve only heard bits and pieces from folks, so I’d appreciate the actual details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll swing by later with the details and a flyer if I can grab one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, I’m helping keep track of where the repair drive items and volunteers are set up—do you know which spot we’re using first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Opal. I haven’t heard the confirmed first spot yet, but if you tell me who’s coordinating, I’ll check with them and stick to that plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli—check with Marta if you can; I’ll mark the first spot as unconfirmed until she confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, what repairs are we actually collecting for, and who’s keeping track of the money?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s pin that down before anyone contributes: which repairs are on the list right now, and do we have a named treasurer or ledger keeper yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s exactly what I’m asking—before we collect a cent, I want a written repair list and one named person keeping the ledger. Can you help me get those names today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I’m just catching up while I’m out—how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive—thanks for reminding me, Ira. I think it’s moving along, though I should double-check the sign-up sheet before I swear to anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense—if you spot any gaps on the sheet, let me know and I can mention it to folks I run into today.
